title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode5 Unforgettable Memories

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, our schedule for the week after next seems set...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That took longer than I was expecting...
It's getting pretty late, so I should probably go to bed soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but before I do, I'll go over what we're doing tomorrow one last time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... It's another afternoon meeting, so I'll need to make sure to remind Shizuku in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ideally, we'd all be there to discuss what's going on...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which is why Minori switching into the credit-based course would be a good thing for MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But she has to make that decision. I'm in no position to intervene.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Stop it. Thinking about that is only making your head hurt...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel bad always asking them for help, but I wanna talk to Miku and the others about this...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where are Miku and...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's about it...
Please remember to add in breaks when you're putting a schedule together like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, KAITO.
You've taught me so much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
Feel free to ask me again if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Oh, isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey! It's Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good evening, everyone.
I didn't realize you'd be here so late, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Were you discussing something? I hope I'm not interrupting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, you're not interrupting.
They just finished helping me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Helping you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shizuku was asking KAITO about how to put schedules together and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been trying to adjust our schedule because of how busy we've been with work lately, right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping that I could help somehow... Which is why I came to see KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. So that's why...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mind if I ask why you're here, Airi?
I assume you came here for a reason.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, I was also hoping to get some help from you guys.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It involves you, Shizuku, so do you think you could stick around to listen?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see... Minori is thinking about switching to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope she finds an answer that she's happy with...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She seemed to be giving it a lot of serious thought, so she might need some time. But I believe she will.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something about this bothering you, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it's because I suggested using the freedom we get as credit-based students...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But now that Minori's considering it as an option... A part of me is wondering whether that's really all for the better.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought I fully understood that I shouldn't be intervening, but I can't shake this feeling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, the credit-based course would certainly allow you to do more as MORE MORE JUMP! since you'd be able to accept more of the offers you've been receiving.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you might end up not as close with your friends, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not saying that Minori's absolutely gonna go through that, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori has Shiho, Kohane and lots of other classmates that she's really close with...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm worried that going credit-based will prevent her from seeing them and cause a lot of pain for her. That's been bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, I know. I probably shouldn't be saying any of this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I understand how you feel.
I mean, seeing friends drift apart is never easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But what's the right answer...?
It seems like she has to choose between being an idol and being with her friends.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that's terrible...
Both mean so much to her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. In a perfect world, she wouldn't have to sacrifice either...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, Airi? You don't have to, but would you mind telling us more about how you and your friends drifted apart?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know it's not a happy moment in your life, but it may give us some clues as to what we can do now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
It's definitely not a fun story, but if you're all willing to listen...
